MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The pipe thread sealant feels useful alongside my hose clamps because it supports the same practical goal of securing and sealing connections.",
    "The epoxy putty and waterproof contact adhesive fit my previous tape and vinyl cement purchases: they offer ways to patch or bond materials. My previous Gorilla tape purchases also make the Gorilla adhesive a familiar option."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs do not fit the small-wire work suggested by my connector assortment; wire size and connection type matter more to me than both products being electrical connectors.",
    "Cutting wheels and exterior wood screws require specific projects I do not currently have, while medical gloves and TENS pads do not address the repair needs reflected in my history.",
    "The infrared thermometer has a different purpose from my inspection camera, and I have no current temperature-measurement need. I also cannot connect the truss hardware to a repair from its title alone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been interpreted as interest in almost any workshop supply, although I choose items for particular repair tasks.",
    "Broad connections such as electrical work or inspection seem to count too much when the recommended item serves a different application."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of tapes, cement, and clamps suggest that bonding, sealing, and securing materials are especially relevant to me.",
    "Compatibility and an identifiable use matter: a connector needs to fit my wire, and a tool or fastener needs a task I actually expect to do."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repairs but stretched it into supplies for unrelated tasks and incompatible applications."
}
